_about: The model families spark-hydra (spark-1 + spark-2) serves, and the engines it has, for scripts/backends/spark-model-intake.sh. DATA: read, never executed. docs/EXL3_PLAYBOOK.md explains every field. A family is one recipe + one image + one unit; a 'drop-in' for it is a checkpoint with the family's model_type, the family's required quantization fields and the same safetensors index KEY SET as the reference checkpoint (index_sha256 = sha256 of the sorted keys joined by newlines, with a trailing newline).
_measured: spark-1, 2026-11-17 (index signatures, sizes, rank files, MemTotal, native capabilities); read-only

pair.notes: MemTotal 127,598,412 kB on each Spark (MEASURED). The DeepSeek recipe runs 98.8 GiB of weights per rank (rank file 106,120,890,008 B) with ~6 GiB MemAvailable left on the head beside the command center: that is the tight end. GLM runs ~82 GiB per rank plus a 10 GiB KV pool. rank_weight_factor: per-rank bytes = checkpoint safetensors bytes / TP x factor, calibrated on DeepSeek (210,601,036,966 B checkpoint -> 106,120,890,008 B rank-1 file = 0.5039 of it).
